description: The Chief Minister urged the youth to carry forward Karnataka’s progressive legacy.
body_lead: The Karnataka government is committed to preparing Kannada for the challenges of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) era to ensure that technological advances do not lead to job losses in the State. Speaking on November 1 at the 70th Karnataka Rajyotsava celebrations organised by the Department of School Education and Literacy, Chief Minister Siddaramaiah said the government’s focus is on strengthening Kannada’s role in the digital age. “The age of information technology is now transforming into the age of AI.
